finalText:
**Found it: `computeTotal` was rounding to the cent twice.**

`engine.js` rounded the USD total to 2 decimals right after applying the percent coupon, and again after the flat coupon — before converting to the order's currency. That threw away fractional cents that should have carried into the currency conversion, so any order with a percent coupon and a non-USD currency (GBP, CAD, JPY) landed a cent or two off. USD and EUR happened to hide it because their rates keep the math clean.

Fix: only round once, at the very end, after converting to the target currency — matching the rule finance expects.

All 40 pricing tests pass now, `node --test tests/pricing-matrix.test.js`.
